senses.gloss: f. (רָגַל) [running, cmp. דּוּשׁ,] in the habit of, wont to.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:8">Bets. III, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 29b:6">29ᵇ</cite>) <he>אצל חנוני הר׳ אצלו</he> to a storekeeper to whom he is used to go.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40a:7">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>הר׳ בחרדל וכ׳</he> who is in the habit of using mustard once in thirty days.
<cite ref="Pesachim 104a:5">Pes. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>הר׳ … ושאינו ר׳ וכ׳</he> he who is conversant (with the prayers) recites several (clauses of the Habdalah), he who is not, recites one.
<cite ref="Ketubot 65a:4">Keth. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ נותנין לה</he> if she is used to wine, it must be given to her; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>רְגִילִים</he>, <he>רְגִילִין</he>; <he>רְגִילוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:4">Yoma VIII, 4</cite> <he>בשביל שיהיו ר׳ במצות</he> that they may become used to religious observances; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 2:12">Tosef. Ber. II, 12</cite> <he>הלכות הר׳</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <he>הרוגליות</he>) Hălakhoth which are familiar to him; <cite ref="Berakhot 22a:6">Ber. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>רְגִילִיּוֹת</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:4:15">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᵈ</cite> <he>רוגליות</he>.
